images.caption: Figure 1:An optimization example with Infrathon.On Quant-VideoGen KV Codec, Claude Opus 5.5 develops a codec that reduces memory use during video generation, with higher KV-cache compression ratios and better video quality than the human codec. Top: two video examples; compression ratios are red. Bottom: Claude’s scores over time combine compression ratio and video quality; dashed line: Human Solution. Numbered points mark five selected submissions; boxes summarize their code changes (AppendixE.3).

Figure 6:Iterative optimization of Quant-VideoGen KV Codec.The figure compares Claude Opus 5.5’s 6th, 7th, 16th, and 22nd submissions with the BF16 reference and the human codec on two LongCat-Video samples. Parentheses show KV-cache compression ratios.
